Name: Star Bull - Red Bull in the Valley
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
Now with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46856]Muttering Farmer Support[/url]!

⚡ Star Bull — Energy Drinks for Stardew Valley. Bring [b]Red Bull and Star Bull[/b] energy drinks into Stardew Valley as [b]new consumable items[/b] with [b]unique buffs[/b], plus a [b]collectible hat[/b] and a[b] vending machine[/b]. Grab your favorite Edition and conquer the day!

[*][b]Themed Vending Machine[/b] delivered by mail after completing [b]Community Center OR Joja[/b][/*]
